description.narrative: Morocco Employability and Land Compact - EDUCATION AND TRAINING FOR EMPLOYABILITY PROJECT - Workforce Development Activity: aims to increase the quality and relevance of technical and vocational education and training (TVET) by supporting private-sector driven governance as well as construction/rehabilitation of 15 training centers, together with targeted investments in policy reform of the sector. This activity is also investing in improvements to job placement services through a results-based financing mechanism as well as improvements to the availability and analysis of labor market data.
